leadFr: Le domaine en photographies, chambre par chambre, saison après saison.
leadEn: The estate in photographs, room by room, season after season.
leadIt: La tenuta in fotografie, camera dopo camera, stagione dopo stagione.

chapters.introFr: Dix chambres, aucune identique. Poutres, parquets et tissus choisis pièce par pièce.
chapters.introEn: Ten rooms, no two alike. Beams, parquet and fabrics chosen one by one.
chapters.introIt: Dieci camere, nessuna uguale. Travi, parquet e tessuti scelti uno a uno.

chapters.introFr: Quatorze hectares, une demeure du XVIᵉ siècle, un étang et une piscine chauffée.
chapters.introEn: Fourteen hectares, a 16th-century house, a pond and a heated pool.
chapters.introIt: Quattordici ettari, una dimora del XVI secolo, uno stagno e una piscina riscaldata.

chapters.introFr: Les pièces de réception, entre feux de cheminée et grandes tablées.
chapters.introEn: The reception rooms, from fireside corners to long shared tables.
chapters.introIt: Le sale di ricevimento, tra camini accesi e grandi tavolate.

chapters.introFr: Petits-déjeuners maison, planches à partager et dîners italiens, servis aux résidents.
chapters.introEn: Homemade breakfasts, sharing boards and Italian dinners, served to guests.
chapters.introIt: Colazioni fatte in casa, taglieri da condividere e cene italiane, per gli ospiti.

chapters.introFr: Mariages, séminaires, retraites et réunions de famille, quand le château se privatise.
chapters.introEn: Weddings, seminars, retreats and family gatherings, when the château is yours alone.
chapters.introIt: Matrimoni, seminari, ritiri e riunioni di famiglia, quando il castello è tutto vostro.
